description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NTranslationImportAPI within the OrangeHRM project. It includes setup procedures, data providers, and test methods primarily focused on creating translations and handling unsupported operations like getAll, delete, etc.

classes.name: I18NTranslationImportAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing the I18NTranslationImportAPI, focusing on create operations and not implemented methods for getAll and delete functionalities.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Prepares the test environment by truncating specific tables and populating fixture data.

methods.name: testCreate
methods.description: Tests the create functionality of the API using data-driven test cases.

methods.name: dataProviderForTestCreate
methods.description: Provides test cases for the create test method, loading data from the specified YAML file.

methods.name: testGetAll
methods.description: Confirms that the getAll method is not implemented and throws the expected exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForGetAll
methods.description: Confirms that the validation rules for getAll are not implemented.

methods.description: Confirms that the delete method is not implemented.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
